title: ChecksEditObservedPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

workspace.description: An absolute path as the environment's operating system writes it: from /, a drive (C:\) or a share (\\).

description: A successful recognised file edit observed through the blocking tool hook, independent of undo snapshot availability; scheduling waits for this Run to complete.
